Read FoML.lean in full: 34 lines, each an `import FoML....` statement or a comment banner grouping them by subdirectory (ToMathlib, ToFoML); no declaration.

Confirmed the two `abbrev` matches in lakefile.lean are the only declaration-keyword hits in that file, and both bind arrays of `LeanOption` build settings, not formal definitions, statements, or proofs.

Spot-checked several substantial files: FoML/Entropy/Dudley.lean (77071 bytes, 73 declarations), FoML/Rademacher/Expectation.lean (66361 bytes, 53 declarations), FoML/ToMathlib/SudakovFernique.lean (47109 bytes, 62 declarations), FoML/ToFoML/OneSidedDeviation.lean (45286 bytes, 45 declarations) -- consistent with a large, genuine statistical-learning-theory formalization.

summary: Ran a declaration-keyword grep over all 44 changed/added files. FoML.lean (root, 0 matches) was read in full: it is a pure list of `import FoML....` statements grouped under comment banners (Generalization, ToMathlib, ToFoML), no declaration of its own -- retained under FILTER-007 as a navigation module. All other FoML/ files (Entropy, ForMathlib, Generalization, Model, Probability, Rademacher, ToFoML, ToMathlib) carry genuine statistical-learning-theory content, matching the prior review's characterization: Rademacher complexity, Dudley entropy integral, McDiarmid/Hoeffding/Bernoulli-Sudakov concentration inequalities, Gaussian process bounds (Sudakov-Fernique, Gaussian tail/max/pi), covering numbers, and RKHS/linear-predictor generalization bounds, with declaration counts from 2 up to 73. lakefile.lean was read in full: `import Lake`/`open Lake DSL`, two `abbrev` declarations (`linter`, `options`) that are Array LeanOption literals configuring the build's linter/pretty-printer options, a `package FoML where` block, a `require mathlib ...`/`require checkdecls ...`/conditional `require doc-gen4 ...`, and a `lean_lib` target -- a format-aware read establishes its two `abbrev`s are Lake build-configuration data, not formal mathematical declarations, so the file holds no unique searchable mathematics under FILTER-004(1); it is excluded, consistent with the same determination already applied to this exact class of file (a Lake package manifest) in another source in this review batch (Beneficial-AI-Foundation/FloatSpec).
